description: Source code for the DIDRegistry service managing DID registries, including storage, retrieval, update, and database synchronization.

classes.name: DIDRegistry
classes.description: Manages DID registries with in-memory storage and database synchronization, supporting CRUD operations and component-based DID lookups.

methods.name: NewDIDRegistryWithStorage
methods.description: Creates a new DIDRegistry instance with provided storage backend.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the registry by loading existing data from the database.

methods.name: GetRegistry
methods.description: Retrieves a registry for a specific agentfield server ID.

methods.name: StoreRegistry
methods.description: Stores a registry both in memory and in the database.

methods.name: DeleteRegistry
methods.description: Deletes a registry for a specific agentfield server ID.

methods.name: UpdateAgentStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an agent within a registry.

methods.name: FindDIDByComponent
methods.description: Finds a DID by component type and function name within a registry.

methods.name: GetAgentDIDs
methods.description: Retrieves all DIDs associated with a specific agent node.
